name: TEGRA
recent: Tegra 于 2026 年 10 月由 Omesti 更名为 Tegra，并在 11 月完成每 5 股合并为 1 股的反向股票分割，合并后股票于 11 月 19 日上市。同期，大股东 Teguh Sedaya 及副董事长 Nur Atisya 持续增持股份，而公司即将公布截至 2026 年 10 月 31 日的第四季度业绩。
notable: 公司完成每 5 股现有普通股合并为 1 股的反向股票分割，合并后股票于 2026 年 11 月 19 日上市交易。
公司名称由 Omesti Berhad 更改为 Tegra Berhad，自 2026 年 10 月 20 日起生效。
副董事长 Nur Atisya 通过 Teguh Sedaya 在 10 月 26 日及 11 月 2 日合计增持约 807.7 万股。
risks: 反向股票分割涉及股份合并，可能影响股东持股的整数单位及零碎股处理。
副董事长在闭门期前表示有意交易公司证券，需留意后续股权变动。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度（截至 7 月 31 日）营收为 3112 万令吉，环比下降 16.9%，但同比增长 77.8%；净利润为 616 万令吉，环比增长 114.9%，净利率从上一季度的 7.6% 提升至 19.8%。

recent_en: Tegra renamed from Omesti in October 2026 and completed a 5-into-1 share consolidation in November, with consolidated shares listed on 19 November. Meanwhile, substantial shareholder Teguh Sedaya and Deputy Chairman Nur Atisya continued to acquire shares, and the company is due to announce its fourth quarter results for the period ended 31 October 2026.
notable_en: The company completed a 5-into-1 share consolidation, with consolidated shares listed for trading on 19 November 2026.
The company changed its name from Omesti Berhad to Tegra Berhad, effective 20 October 2026.
Deputy Chairman Nur Atisya, via Teguh Sedaya, acquired a total of approximately 8.077 million shares on 26 October and 2 November.
risks_en: The share consolidation may affect shareholders' shareholdings in terms of board lots and fractional entitlements.
The Deputy Chairman has indicated an intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period, and subsequent shareholding changes should be monitored.
earnings_en: For the third quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 31.12 million, down 16.9% QoQ but up 77.8% YoY; net income was MYR 6.16 million, up 114.9% QoQ, with net margin improving to 19.8% from 7.6% in the previous quarter.
